name: title2-pdf-check
title: PDF Accessibility Basics Check (ADA Title II)
description: Checks the PDFs on one website (or a list of PDF links) for four basics screen readers rely on: tags, a document language, a title and real text, and says in plain words what to fix. Machine checks only; not a WCAG conformance judgment. Apache-2.0. Made by MV2 of Munim, Inc. with AI agents.
